visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige sleeveless crop top and black leggings, stands on a jagged dark rocky outcrop. She is facing away from the camera initially, then turns her side, adjusting her hair with both hands behind her head. In the background, the sharp, pyramidal, snow-dusted peak of the Matterhorn stands prominently against a clear, deep blue sky. (2) The perspective shifts to a view through a window, likely from a moving train or cable car, looking through green larch trees at the snow-capped Matterhorn peak. (3) A red mountain train with multiple carriages climbs a steep grassy slope with patches of melting snow; a small rustic wooden mountain hut with a stone roof sits in the lower left foreground. (4) The camera looks out from the front window of a modern train moving along tracks bordered by thick snow banks, heading directly toward the Matterhorn under the bright sun. (5) A close-up selfie-style shot shows the woman wearing a light grey hooded sweatshirt, smiling at the camera with the Matterhorn and a snowy mountain range behind her. (6) The woman, seen from behind, walks along a narrow snowy path on a mountain ridge, wearing a small black backpack and black leggings. (7) Finally, the woman walks toward the camera on the snowy path, wearing the grey hoodie, laughing heartily with a wide smile, and holding a pair of sunglasses in her hand while the vast snowy Alpine landscape stretches behind her.
